name: android-operation-status-and-cancel
scope: Android now uses a reusable OperationStatusCard for Run actions and AI world drafting. Stage transitions yield to Flutter rendering so connecting is observable before a slow local model call; cancellation is hidden once state application begins.
changes: mobile/lib/widgets/operation_status.dart centralizes progress, elapsed time, stage labels, slow-model guidance and cancellation action
PlayPage uses the shared card and only exposes cancellation in preparing/connecting/generating
AI world drafting shows preparing/connecting/generating/applying and retains zero-write cancellation semantics
tests avoid waiting for an intentionally live operation clock while a model future is pending
the Play entry now leads with the current story location instead of Python/revision jargon
remaining: Physical Android device install and real slow-model/failure/accessibility acceptance
Windows native package and WebView journey
macOS installed WebView full A-F acceptance
